fruits.extendedStory: Christian IV ordered this tower and Hans van Steenwinckel the Younger built it, finished in 1642. It stands 34.8 metres. Inside there is no staircase. A brick ramp winds round and round the core instead. That is how instruments, and the occasional horse, were got to the top. It was built as an observatory, so the point was always what you could see from up there.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Christian IV. gab den Turm in Auftrag, Hans van Steenwinckel der Jüngere baute ihn, fertig 1642. Er misst 34,8 Meter. Drinnen gibt es keine Treppe. Stattdessen windet sich eine gemauerte Rampe um den Kern, und so kamen Instrumente und gelegentlich ein Pferd nach oben. Gebaut wurde er als Sternwarte, es ging also immer darum, was man von dort oben sieht.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Christian IV ordered this tower and Hans van Steenwinckel the Younger built it, finished in 1642. It stands 34.8 metres. Inside there is no staircase. A brick ramp winds round and round the core instead. That is how instruments, and the occasional horse, were got to the top. It was built as an observatory, so the point was always what you could see from up there.

localizedStory.de: Ein runder Turm von 1642 ohne Treppe. Stattdessen windet sich eine gemauerte Rampe hinauf.
localizedStory.en: A round tower of 1642 with no stairs inside. A brick ramp spirals up it instead.

fruits.name: Rundetårn
fruits.story: A round tower of 1642 with no stairs inside. A brick ramp spirals up it instead.

fruits.extendedStory: Elias David Häusser drew this palace and work began in 1740. The style is baroque, which means weight, symmetry and a great deal of front. It carries the name of Christian VI, the king who ordered it. Denmark still runs a good deal of its business from this address. Few buildings anywhere hold a parliament, a court and a royal household at the same time.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Elias David Häusser entwarf dieses Schloss, 1740 begannen die Arbeiten. Der Stil ist barock, also Gewicht, Symmetrie und sehr viel Fassade. Es trägt den Namen Christians VI., des Königs, der es bestellte. Dänemark wickelt bis heute einiges an dieser Adresse ab. Kaum ein Bau beherbergt zugleich Parlament, Gericht und ein Königshaus.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Elias David Häusser drew this palace and work began in 1740. The style is baroque, which means weight, symmetry and a great deal of front. It carries the name of Christian VI, the king who ordered it. Denmark still runs a good deal of its business from this address. Few buildings anywhere hold a parliament, a court and a royal household at the same time.

localizedStory.de: Ein Barockschloss, 1740 begonnen und nach Christian VI. benannt, dem König, der es wollte.
localizedStory.en: A baroque palace begun in 1740 and named for Christian VI, the king who wanted it.

fruits.name: Christiansborg Slot
fruits.story: A baroque palace begun in 1740 and named for Christian VI, the king who wanted it.

fruits.extendedStory: Christian Frederik Hansen rebuilt this church and it was finished in 1829. He worked in the Neoclassical manner, which looks back to Greek and Roman building for straight lines and calm surfaces. There is very little decoration. The church belongs to Mary. After the noise of the street the plainness inside is the whole effect, and it is deliberate.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Christian Frederik Hansen baute diese Kirche neu, 1829 war sie fertig. Er arbeitete klassizistisch, ein Stil, der bei Griechen und Römern gerade Linien und ruhige Flächen holt. Schmuck gibt es kaum. Die Kirche gehört Maria. Nach dem Lärm der Straße ist die Schlichtheit drinnen die ganze Wirkung, und sie ist gewollt.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Christian Frederik Hansen rebuilt this church and it was finished in 1829. He worked in the Neoclassical manner, which looks back to Greek and Roman building for straight lines and calm surfaces. There is very little decoration. The church belongs to Mary. After the noise of the street the plainness inside is the whole effect, and it is deliberate.

localizedStory.de: Eine Kirche für Maria, 1829 von Christian Frederik Hansen in klarer, gerader Weise neu gebaut.
localizedStory.en: A church for Mary, rebuilt in 1829 by Christian Frederik Hansen in a plain, straight-lined manner.

fruits.name: Vor Frue Kirke
fruits.story: A church for Mary, rebuilt in 1829 by Christian Frederik Hansen in a plain, straight-lined manner.

fruits.extendedStory: Martin Nyrop designed this and it was finished in 1905. The style is Art Nouveau, which took its shapes from plants and insisted that a building be looked at closely. Nyrop cared about the craft as much as the plan. Brick, ironwork and carving were meant to be handled by people who knew what they were doing. Stand near the doorway and look at the detail rather than the whole.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Martin Nyrop entwarf es, 1905 war es fertig. Der Stil ist Jugendstil, der seine Formen von Pflanzen nahm und darauf bestand, dass man ein Haus aus der Nähe ansieht. Nyrop lag am Handwerk so viel wie am Entwurf. Ziegel, Eisen und Schnitzerei sollten durch Hände gehen, die ihr Fach beherrschten. Stell dich ans Portal und schau auf das Detail, nicht auf das Ganze.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Martin Nyrop designed this and it was finished in 1905. The style is Art Nouveau, which took its shapes from plants and insisted that a building be looked at closely. Nyrop cared about the craft as much as the plan. Brick, ironwork and carving were meant to be handled by people who knew what they were doing. Stand near the doorway and look at the detail rather than the whole.

localizedStory.de: Martin Nyrops Rathaus, 1905 vollendet, im Jugendstil mit seinen Kurven und Feinheiten.
localizedStory.en: Martin Nyrop's city hall, finished in 1905, built in the Art Nouveau manner of curves and detail.

fruits.name: Københavns Rådhus
fruits.story: Martin Nyrop's city hall, finished in 1905, built in the Art Nouveau manner of curves and detail.

fruits.extendedStory: A church has stood on this ground since 1400 and it belongs to the Holy Spirit. Copenhagen has burned more than once, and buildings here are rarely all of one age. This one was put up again in 1732. The old and the new sit in the same walls. Look for the joins, because a city that keeps rebuilding leaves its seams showing.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Seit 1400 steht hier eine Kirche, und sie gehört dem Heiligen Geist. Kopenhagen hat mehr als einmal gebrannt, und Häuser sind hier selten aus einem Guss. Dieses wurde 1732 wieder aufgerichtet. Altes und Neues stecken in denselben Mauern. Achte auf die Nähte, denn eine Stadt, die immer wieder baut, zeigt ihre Fugen.
localizedExtendedStory.en: A church has stood on this ground since 1400 and it belongs to the Holy Spirit. Copenhagen has burned more than once, and buildings here are rarely all of one age. This one was put up again in 1732. The old and the new sit in the same walls. Look for the joins, because a city that keeps rebuilding leaves its seams showing.

localizedStory.de: Eine Kirche des Heiligen Geistes, seit 1400 an dieser Stelle, 1732 erneut aufgebaut.
localizedStory.en: A church of the Holy Spirit, standing here since 1400, rebuilt again in 1732.

fruits.name: Helligåndskirken

fruits.extendedStory: On 22 May 1807 the royal cabinet of curiosities became a national collection, under Christian Jurgensen Thomsen. It sits in the Prince's Mansion, a rococo house. Inside are the Trundholm sun chariot and the Gundestrup cauldron. The golden horns of Gallehus are here as copies. The originals were stolen in 1802 and melted down, which is why nobody will ever see them again.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Am 22. Mai 1807 wurde aus der königlichen Kunstkammer eine Nationalsammlung, unter Christian Jurgensen Thomsen. Sie sitzt im Prinzenpalais, einem Rokokohaus. Drinnen stehen der Sonnenwagen von Trundholm und der Kessel von Gundestrup. Die Goldhörner von Gallehus liegen hier als Kopien. Die Originale wurden 1802 gestohlen und eingeschmolzen, und darum wird sie nie wieder jemand sehen.
localizedExtendedStory.en: On 22 May 1807 the royal cabinet of curiosities became a national collection, under Christian Jurgensen Thomsen. It sits in the Prince's Mansion, a rococo house. Inside are the Trundholm sun chariot and the Gundestrup cauldron. The golden horns of Gallehus are here as copies. The originals were stolen in 1802 and melted down, which is why nobody will ever see them again.

localizedStory.de: Dänemarks Sammlung begann 1807 als königliche Kunstkammer, und sie hat alles behalten.
localizedStory.en: Denmark's collection began in 1807 as a royal cabinet of curiosities, and it kept everything.

fruits.name: Nationalmuseet
fruits.story: Denmark's collection began in 1807 as a royal cabinet of curiosities, and it kept everything.

fruits.extendedStory: This opened in 1848 and it was built around one man. Bertel Thorvaldsen was a sculptor, and the building holds his work and carries his name. Museums usually gather what they can from everywhere. This one was raised for one artist while people still remembered him working. The walls stand about 18 metres, and the colours outside are nothing like the grey around them.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Es öffnete 1848 und wurde um einen Mann herum gebaut. Bertel Thorvaldsen war Bildhauer, das Haus bewahrt sein Werk und trägt seinen Namen. Museen tragen sonst zusammen, was sie überall bekommen. Dieses entstand für einen Künstler, als man ihn noch bei der Arbeit erinnerte. Die Mauern messen etwa 18 Meter, und die Farben außen haben nichts mit dem Grau ringsum zu tun.
localizedExtendedStory.en: This opened in 1848 and it was built around one man. Bertel Thorvaldsen was a sculptor, and the building holds his work and carries his name. Museums usually gather what they can from everywhere. This one was raised for one artist while people still remembered him working. The walls stand about 18 metres, and the colours outside are nothing like the grey around them.

localizedStory.de: Ein Museum von 1848, um einen Bildhauer herum gebaut, Bertel Thorvaldsen, und um sein Werk.
localizedStory.en: A museum of 1848 built around one sculptor, Bertel Thorvaldsen, and around his own work.

fruits.name: Thorvaldsens Museum
fruits.story: A museum of 1848 built around one sculptor, Bertel Thorvaldsen, and around his own work.

fruits.extendedStory: Ramparts ran across here once, and the way in was the Western City Gate, with a hay market beside it. The walls came down in the 1850s and left a hole in the middle of the city. Martin Nyrop won the competition to fill it in 1889. The square opened in 1905. Two bronze lur blowers stand on a column 20 metres up, and nearby a gilded sign turns to tell you the weather.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Hier verliefen einmal Wälle, und der Weg hinein war das Westtor, daneben ein Heumarkt. In den 1850er Jahren fielen die Mauern und ließen ein Loch mitten in der Stadt. Martin Nyrop gewann 1889 den Wettbewerb, 1894 wurde der Grundstein gelegt, 1905 öffnete der Platz. Zwei bronzene Lurenbläser stehen auf einer Säule, 20 Meter hoch. Nebenan dreht sich ein vergoldetes Zeichen und sagt das Wetter an.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Ramparts ran across here once, and the way in was the Western City Gate, with a hay market beside it. The walls came down in the 1850s and left a hole in the middle of the city. Martin Nyrop won the competition to fill it in 1889. The square opened in 1905. Two bronze lur blowers stand on a column 20 metres up, and nearby a gilded sign turns to tell you the weather.

localizedStory.de: Achte auf das vergoldete Wetterzeichen. Mädchen auf dem Rad heißt schön. Mädchen mit Schirm heißt Regen.
localizedStory.en: Watch the gilded weather sign. A girl on a bicycle means fine. A girl with an umbrella means rain.

fruits.name: Rådhuspladsen
fruits.story: Watch the gilded weather sign. A girl on a bicycle means fine. A girl with an umbrella means rain.

fruits.extendedStory: Before 1670 this was a mess of old rampart remains and heaps of rubbish, impassable when it rained. Christian V was crowned that year and had the whole thing levelled and cobbled. In the middle stands his own statue on horseback, cut by the French sculptor Abraham-Cesar Lamoureux in 1688. Around it runs an oval garden the Danes call Krinsen, from an old word for a wreath.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Vor 1670 lag hier ein Durcheinander aus Wallresten und Abfallhaufen, bei Regen unpassierbar. Christian V. wurde in jenem Jahr gekrönt und ließ alles einebnen und pflastern. In der Mitte steht sein eigenes Reiterstandbild, 1688 vom französischen Bildhauer Abraham-Cesar Lamoureux gehauen. Ringsum liegt ein ovaler Garten, den die Dänen Krinsen nennen, nach einem alten Wort für Kranz.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Before 1670 this was a mess of old rampart remains and heaps of rubbish, impassable when it rained. Christian V was crowned that year and had the whole thing levelled and cobbled. In the middle stands his own statue on horseback, cut by the French sculptor Abraham-Cesar Lamoureux in 1688. Around it runs an oval garden the Danes call Krinsen, from an old word for a wreath.

localizedStory.de: Christian V. ließ diesen Grund nach seiner Krönung 1670 planieren und pflastern. Vorher lag hier Abfall.
localizedStory.en: Christian V had this ground levelled and cobbled after his coronation in 1670. It had been a rubbish tip.
